description: Executable compatibility fixtures for the Forma portable workflow format. Each entry names the file, the compatibility class Forma validation must report, and what it proves. tests/workflow runs every entry.

fixtures.proves: The smallest valid workflow: one node, no layout.
A linear multi-step workflow with provenance.
A decision with labelled conditional branches and a loop back.
Groups and containers with explicit membership and nesting.
Swimlanes and a phase that crosses lanes.
Literal, token and palette colours unrelated to status, with a legend (FMD-TEST-007).
Arbitrary node and workflow metadata, plus typed domain references.
Edge metadata, semantic edge kinds and edge status.
Namespaced extension data at workflow, node and edge level survives unchanged.
A workflow with no coordinates; the deterministic default layout places it.
Accessible names and descriptions, and labelled branches.
A top-to-bottom compact workflow for narrow screens.
Token-backed palette slots that a Forma brand restyles.
Runtime status projected onto a read-only embedded workflow.
Ports, interaction intents and host extension data in an editable embedded workflow.
Authored geometry; the reference for static HTML export (exports/static-export.*.html).
Declarative interaction intents; the reference for interactive HTML export (exports/interactive-export.document.html).
Ports with direction and cardinality, core and namespaced status states.
An explicit producer metadata-to-colour mapping with a legend (FMD-TEST-008).
